Sampling distribution of the sample mean样本均值的抽样分布

Central Limit Theorem visualizer中心极限定理可视化

Pick a population shape and a sample size n. The simulator draws many random samples of size n, computes each sample mean, and stacks the means into a histogram. Whatever the population looks like, the means pile up in a bell shape centered at mu with spread sigma divided by the square root of n, and the fit improves as n grows.选择总体形状和样本量 n。模拟器抽取许多个容量为 n 的随机样本，计算每个样本的均值，并把这些均值堆成直方图。无论总体长什么样，样本均值都会堆成以 mu 为中心、离散程度为 sigma 除以 n 的平方根的钟形，且 n 越大拟合越好。

Controls控制

Population shape总体形状
Sample size n样本量 n
Number of samples样本个数

The same seed and settings always reproduce the same picture. Keyboard: Tab to a button, then press Enter or Space.相同的种子与设置总会得到相同的图形。键盘操作：用 Tab 移到按钮，再按 Enter 或空格。

  • Normal curve with mean mu and SD sigma/sqrt(n)均值为 mu、标准差为 sigma/sqrt(n) 的正态曲线
  • Population mean mu总体均值 mu

The mean of the sample means stays at mu for every n. Only the spread shrinks, by a factor of sqrt(n). Quadrupling n cuts the SD of x-bar in half.对任何 n，样本均值的均值都保持为 mu，只有离散程度按 sqrt(n) 的倍数缩小。n 变为 4 倍，x-bar 的标准差减半。

Top panel: the population density. Bottom panel: sample means, drawn on a zoomed axis (mu plus or minus 4 sigma/sqrt n) so the narrowing is visible. Synthetic teaching data; no network needed.上图为总体密度，下图为样本均值，坐标轴已放大（mu 加减 4 倍 sigma/sqrt n），便于看清离散程度如何变小。 合成教学数据，无需联网。
